---
title: "Runtime relative to CAVI-Q2"
subtitle: "Wall-clock speedup of gIBSS-Q2, gIBSS-Laplace, local-JJ, global-JJ and score over CAVI-Q2 in experiments 022-024, at L=5 and L=1"
engine: jupyter
jupyter: python3
execute:
  fig-dpi: 110
---


`fit_seconds` times the `fit_glm_susie` call alone. Simulation, ELBO scoring and reductions
are not included. Every timing comes from one machine: Midway caslake, one core per SLURM job.
The 022 grid ran on a laptop under parallel load, so 022 uses batch 0 of each cell rerun on
Midway (`022-laplace-timing`, `022-laplace-ser-timing`, 10 replicates per cell). 023 and 024
use all 200 replicates.

The first replicate of every batch also pays JAX compilation, because each fit job is a fresh
process. Ratios use replicates 2-10 of each batch; compilation is in its own table below. An
arm's time is divided by CAVI-Q2's time on the same replicate, and ratios are averaged on the
log scale. Null cells are included.

::: {#status .cell execution_count=2}
- 022, L=5: 30 batches, 300 CAVI-Q2 fits, 1350 paired steady-state arm fits
- 022, L=1: 18 batches, 180 CAVI-Q2 fits, 810 paired steady-state arm fits
- 023, L=5: 260 batches, 2600 CAVI-Q2 fits, 11700 paired steady-state arm fits
- 023, L=1: 140 batches, 1400 CAVI-Q2 fits, 6300 paired steady-state arm fits
- 024, L=5: 660 batches, 6600 CAVI-Q2 fits, 29700 paired steady-state arm fits
- 024, L=1: 340 batches, 3400 CAVI-Q2 fits, 15300 paired steady-state arm fits
:::

| exp | L | gIBSS-Q2 | gIBSS-Laplace | local-JJ | global-JJ | score |

| 023 | 5 | 12.1 (12.0, 12.2) | 93.5 (92.6, 94.3) | 61.9 (61.0, 62.9) | 262.4 (257.0, 267.9) | 249.1 (245.6, 252.4) |
| 024 | 1 | 2.7 (2.7, 2.7) | 4.1 (4.1, 4.2) | 3.2 (3.2, 3.2) | 12.0 (11.9, 12.2) | 12.9 (12.8, 13.0) |
| 024 | 5 | 3.3 (3.3, 3.3) | 10.9 (10.9, 11.0) | 4.0 (3.9, 4.0) | 24.2 (24.0, 24.4) | 24.0 (23.9, 24.2) |

*exp*: experiment (022 binary Markov sets, 023 Gaussian AR(1), 024 nested sets). *L*: number of fitted components. Each arm column: geometric mean over paired replicates of CAVI-Q2 seconds / arm seconds, with a 95% interval from resampling replicates. Values above 1 mean the arm is faster than CAVI-Q2.
